questions.question: What features should the frontend include?
questions.answer: Overview dashboard; playable local AI and two-player modes; undo and move history; statistics and chart; searchable, filterable, paginated game-history explorer; settings; responsive premium dark UI with motion and icons; README and navigation/game tests.
questions.rationale: These requirements are directly specified in the request; game records and preferences will persist locally in the browser.
questions.recommendedChoice: Overview dashboard; playable local AI and two-player modes; undo and move history; statistics and chart; searchable, filterable, paginated game-history explorer; settings; responsive premium dark UI with motion and icons; README and navigation/game tests.

questions.question: Which data stores are required?
questions.rationale: This is an offline, frontend-only application; game history and settings can use browser-local storage without a backend datastore.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Keep the application client-side and persist preferences and game records in browser storage.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Relational database for centrally stored application data.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational database for centrally stored application data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for files and media.
